# dsh-suggest-ghost bundle patch：把 host 插件行插入 loader 树。
# 作为 dsh.bundle.patch 自动挂载（dsh plugin add 后即生效）；

readme.section: Introduction
dsh-suggest-ghost
readme.text:
[English](README.en.md) | **简体中文**

[](https://github.com/dsh-plugin-collection/dsh-suggest-ghost)
[](LICENSE)
[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

> DeepSeek Harness Web 输入预测插件：回合结束后用一次辅助 LLM 调用预测你的下一条提示词，草稿为空时以幽灵文本显示在输入框里；输入过程中则从当前会话历史找前缀补全。Tab 整条采纳，→ 逐词采纳。

readme.section: 这是什么
readme.text:
- **LLM 下一条建议**（草稿为空）：每个回合完成后，把最近几轮对话脱敏后发给建议模型（默认继承主请求路由，不额外配置），产出一条「你大概率会输入的下一句」——Claude Code 同款体验。长会话开启摘要后，早期目标与偏好也会保留，建议质量不随会话长度下降。
- **历史前缀补全**（草稿非空）：zsh autosuggestions 式——从会话历史找前缀命中项，按新近度为主、会话内频次与跨会话热度为辅打分取最优，灰色显示剩余部分。全/半角标点、空白、大小写差异不影响匹配。即时、无网络。
- **停顿续写**（草稿非空）：输入停 `inlineDelayMs`（默认 100ms）后发一次续写请求，把光标处的下半句以幽灵补出，Tab 整条采纳、`→` 逐词采纳。**耗时与体感预期**：`inlineDelayMs` 只决定"何时发请求"，模型返回本身实测 **1.1~17 秒**（2026-10-20 真实环境 42 次生成：最快 1100ms、中位 4900ms、最慢 16986ms），所以停顿后马上等通常看不到。期间再敲字会中止在途请求并重新开始 —— 但**已经到达的那份续写仍会按对齐判据显示**，不再被丢弃，这类中止在宿主日志里逐次可见（`completion-preempted` / `completion-aborted` / `completion-timeout`）。

readme.section: 这是什么
readme.text: 幽灵文本是 DOM overlay 近似渲染（跟随输入框字体、跟随滚动），不依赖官方 `setGhost` 输入机能力，rc.6 即可运行；中文输入法组合期间不拦截按键。

readme.section: 效果预览
readme.text:
**① 历史前缀补全**（草稿非空）——输入「列出 do」，幽灵自动补全这条历史消息的剩余部分：

**② LLM 下一条建议**（草稿为空，回合结束自动预测下一步）：

深色文字 = 已输入；灰色 = 幽灵建议。**Tab** 整条采纳，**→** 逐词采纳。幽灵文本跟随输入框字体与滚动渲染，不遮挡、不抢焦点；不合意就无视它，继续打字即消失——零成本。

readme.section: 安装
readme.text:
**npm 安装（推荐，预构建产物，无需授权）：**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-suggest-ghost
```

> **想改代码请从这里看起：`src/` 是源码，`lib/` 是 `npm run build` 生成的产物。**
> 直接改 `lib/` 会在下次构建时被静默覆盖 —— 细节见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。

从 GitHub 一行安装（构建产物已随仓库提交，无需本地构建）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:WuJiaoJue/dsh-suggest-ghost"
```

或者源码方式：

readme.section: 安装
readme.text:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/dsh-plugin-collection/dsh-suggest-ghost.git
cd dsh-suggest-ghost && pnpm install && pnpm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

装完重启 dsh web，页面 Ctrl+Shift+R 硬刷新。开箱即用，无需任何配置。

readme.section: 配置
readme.text:
全部设置在 Settings → Plugins 面板的 Suggest ghost 卡片，保存后即时生效：
卡片文案（字段 label/hint、按钮、徽章）跟随宿主 DSH 界面语言（中文 / English），
设置页切换语言后实时跟随，无需刷新；旧宿主无 locale 服务时回退中文。

readme.section: 配置
readme.text:
| 分组 | 字段 |
|---|---|
| LLM 下一条建议 | 启用开关、输出令牌上限、建议字符上限、参考回合数、转录字符预算、超时（毫秒）、采纳快捷键、provider / model 路由（留空继承主请求）、**建议推理档位 `suggestionReasoningEffort`（默认为空 = 不传）** |
| 停顿续写 | 启用开关、停顿时长（默认 100ms）、最少输入字符（停顿续写）、续写长度上限、**续写推理档位 `completionReasoningEffort`（默认为空 = 不传）** |
| 历史前缀补全 | 启用开关、跨会话搜索、最大历史条目、最少输入字符（历史补全）、逐词采纳 |
| 热度管理 | 跨会话高频短语列表：固定（不参与淘汰、候选恒置顶）、删除、手工新增（默认固定）、清空全部——即时生效，无需保存 |

readme.section: 配置
readme.text:
**推理档位为什么默认留空**：`reasoningEffort` 是**按 provider、按 model** 声明的，不是全局开关。
本机 profile 的 18 个模型里有 9 个根本没声明 `reasoningEfforts`（efficient / fast / lite 等），
给它们带任何档位都会在**请求发出之前**被适配器拒掉（`UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT`，
实测 0-20ms 失败）。所以默认空串 = 插件不写这个键 = 沿用该路由自己的默认档位。
填了模型没声明的档位也不会让这一轮没有建议：宿主会退一档（不带档位）重发一次，
宿主日志里记 `effort_rejected=1`。也别拿它当「关思考」用——只有显式声明了 `off` / `none`
的路由才接受这类值（qfmodel 连 `off` 都拒，profile 只声明 low/medium/xhigh）。

readme.section: 配置
readme.text:
> 档位能省多少时间取决于模型：同一沙箱内测得 `qfmodel` 缺省 1468ms、带 `low` 828ms
> （约 1.8x），而 `efficient` 缺省就要 6238ms。**换模型比调档位是更大的杠杆（约 4x）**。
> 辅助调用的首块延迟、增量数与请求档位现在都写在留痕行里
> （`suggestion generated …` / `completion generated …`，含
> `first_text_delta_ms` / `first_reasoning_delta_ms` / `outcome=empty|filtered`）。

也可以在 cordis.patch.yml 按 id 覆盖（作为上述项的初始值）：

```yaml
- id: suggest-ghost
  config:
    maxInputBytes: 4096        # 框架化用户提示字节上限
    maxOutputTokens: 512       # 建议输出令牌上限

readme.section: 配置
安全
readme.text:
- 默认取最近 3 轮对话发给建议模型，开启长会话摘要后旧消息的关键信息也会保留；发送前自动脱敏常见凭据；输出经净化，不合格回复静默丢弃
- 全程有界：输入字节 / 输出 token / 超时封顶；同回合防重入，新回合作废旧生成，卸载即中止在途请求

readme.section: 兼容性
readme.text:
**现状（2026-10-30）**：支持 **6 个代次** —— `0.1.2-rc.1 / 0.1.5-rc.3 / 0.1.7-rc.1 / 0.1.7-rc.2 /
0.2.0-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.2`；`0.2.2-alpha.2` 是**预发布线**，已登记进代次表并跑过装配 / 门禁 / 类型 /
投影四面（`npm run verify:kernels` 与 `scripts/cross-kernel/type-surface.mjs` 全 GREEN），
但它**不是对 `0.2.2` 正式版的承诺**。`0.1.1-rc.2` 已从支持列表**删除**：它的前端没有
`remote.settings` 这个服务，而 cordis 对 `inject` 是静态 park（声明了拿不到就整条 fiber 不激活），
运行时降级做不到 —— 硬约束证据与对照实验在 `scripts/cross-kernel/FINDINGS.md` 顶部与 §20。
**下文任何提到 `0.1.1-rc.2` 的段落都是历史记录。**

readme.text:
| DSH 内核 | 准入门禁 | 装配 + 投影注册 | 类型面 | UI 面（真 GUI 有截图） |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `0.1.2-rc.1` | ⚪ 该代不导出 evaluator ⇒ **未判定** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ FINDINGS §13 |
| `0.1.5-rc.3` | ⚪ 同上 ⇒ **未判定** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ FINDINGS §13 |
| `0.1.7-rc.1` | ✅ 仅 peer | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ FINDINGS §13 |
| `0.1.7-rc.2` | ✅ 仅 peer | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ FINDINGS §8 / §12 |
| `0.2.0-rc.2` | ✅ 仅 peer | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ FINDINGS §8 |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` | ✅ `engines.dsh` 单独决定 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ FINDINGS §8 / §12 |
| `0.2.2-alpha.2` | ✅ `engines.dsh` 单独决定 | ✅ | ✅ | ⏳ **未判定**（FINDINGS §20.6，别当绿） |

readme.section: 兼容性
readme.text:
三条读数纪律：**未判定 ≠ 绿**（前两代根本没有闸，"装配 GREEN"不证明准入验证过）；
`peerDependencies` 的逐代枚举 ≠ 内核的匹配口径（见下一节两套口径）；
UI 面是四面里唯一能回答"用户到底看见没看见"的那一面，也是**最容易被前三面全绿掩盖**的一支。

readme.section: peer 枚举，以及 0.2.0 才开始有的硬门禁
readme.text:
peer 依赖写成 `^0.1.2-rc.1 || ^0.1.5-rc.1 || ^0.1.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.0-rc.2` 这种**逐代枚举**
（今天 `package.json` 里那 6 个 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer，每一条都是这一串），而不是 `>=0.1.2-rc.1`。
原因分两套口径，**别把它们当同一套**：

readme.section: peer 枚举，以及 0.2.0 才开始有的硬门禁
readme.text:
- **安装面**（npm/pnpm 解 peer，不带 `includePrerelease`）：node-semver 默认不把预发布版算进任何范围，
  只有比较符带同一 `[major.minor.patch]` 元组时才放行 ⇒ `^0.1.2-rc.1` 对 `0.1.5-rc.1` 为假、`*` 同样为假，
  **跨代没有区间写法**，每发布一根新 rc 就得补一个枚举项。
- **准入口径**（内核自己判，`semver.satisfies(v, range, { includePrerelease: true })`）：
  实测 `^0.1.2-rc.1` **覆盖 0.1.x 全部**（含 `0.1.7-rc.1`），`^0.2.0-rc.2` 覆盖
  `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0` 的**全部**（含 `0.2.1-rc.5` 与 `0.2.2-alpha.2`）；上面那四条在 npm 口径下**全是 false**。

readme.section: peer 枚举，以及 0.2.0 才开始有的硬门禁
readme.text:
⇒ **"补枚举项"是安装面的事，不是准入要求**。本仓因此没有为一根 alpha 放宽 peer
（那等于把未验证的代次写进支持声明）；`0.2.2` 正式版出来时两种口径都自动覆盖，
届时只需在代次表新增一条并重跑（2026-10-30 实测，FINDINGS §20.4）。

**`0.2.0` 起这条从「安装期提示」升级为「加载期硬拒绝」**：内核在组装 profile 时逐条用
`semver.satisfies(runtimeVersion, range, { includePrerelease: true })` 校验 peer
（`dsh-app-boot` 的插件兼容性检查），不满足就整个 bundle 跳过：

```
dsh: skipping profile bundle "dsh-suggest-ghost": Error: Plugin … is incompatible
with dsh 0.2.0-rc.2: peerDependencies {…}
```

两点值得记住：

readme.section: peer 枚举，以及 0.2.0 才开始有的硬门禁
readme.text:
- 门禁带 **`includePrerelease: true`**，但它**不是万能放行**：`^0.2.0`（不带 rc）对 `0.2.0-rc.2` 仍然判假
  （实测两种口径都是 false），要放行这一代就得把下界写成带 rc 的 `^0.2.0-rc.2`；
- 需要临时放行时可以用 `dsh plugin allow-version` 给**精确版本**豁免，但那是绕过检查，不是修复 ——
  准入面的正解是**代次表登记 + 重跑**（`scripts/cross-kernel/generations.mjs`），
  安装面的正解才是**补枚举项**。两者别混，见上面那两套口径。

readme.section: 0.1.7 的 settings 体系变更（源码里唯一的大改）
readme.text:
| | `0.1.5` | `0.1.7+` |
|---|---|---|
| 用户可调项 | `ctx.settings.register(ns, schema, …)` 注册命名空间 | `Config` 里逐字段 `.volatile()`，内核把**插件自己的 Config schema** 投影成表单，ns = Loader 条目 id |
| host → client | `SettingsScope` 的 `_push` 字段 | `ctx.settings.update(ns, {_push, _hot})`（两格都标 volatile；`_push` = 建议格，`_hot` = 热度/历史格） |
| client 读取 | `settingsScope.bind(ns).get()` | `remote.settings.describe()`（首读 + 事件驱动重读）|
| client → host | `scope.set('_ops', …)` | `remote.settings.mutate(ns, [{op:'set',path:['_ops'],…}])` |
| 变更通知（host） | `scope.watch` | `settings/document-updated(ns, revision)` 事件 |
| 变更通知（client） | `scope.subscribe` | `remote.$on('settings/document-updated')` |

readme.section: 0.1.7 的 settings 体系变更（源码里唯一的大改）
readme.text:
**载荷结构的归属守卫（`suggestionSessionId` / `historySessionId` / `completionSessionId`）
逐字未变**，变的只是载体。0.6.1 起 host → client 分**两格**：`_push` 只装
`{suggestion(+frame/final), suggestionSessionId, completion(+final), error}`，`_hot` 只装
`{hot, total, history, historySessionId}`——两格各自判重，一次纯热度变化不再连带重写建议格。
**两格都脏时合并成一次 `settings.update`**（省的是客户端一次重解析，不是「一次整档重写」：
补写泵不排队，各写各的最坏只多等一个 500ms tick）。缺省语义按格成立：整格缺席 = 保留现值，
**不是**清空——旧宿主没有 `_hot` 时客户端的热度与历史必须原样留着。

readme.section: 0.1.7 的 settings 体系变更（源码里唯一的大改）
readme.text:
> **热度格写合并窗口（1000ms）**：只合并**纯热度**的变化（连续输入、一批多 op）；**建议格永远
> 立即写**，不被窗口拖慢；**`pull` 与 `complete`（客户端正在合成时发的那条）都会让路** —— 窗口未到期时立刻把当前
> 热度放出去，因为那正是「有人马上要用热表」的时刻。热表恢复后的那次
> 补推与插件卸载前的那一次同样绕开窗口。**用户可见代价**：热表**排序**可能滞后 ≤1.5s，
> **不影响建议本身**。实测（真实会话日志 + 纯函数判定，**120 会话 / 8134 次判定**）：
> 「这次没补出来」的无条件比例 ≈ **0.033%**（3 例）；而「落后一整个回合」的代价是 12.6% ——
> **窗口的可见代价取决于「用户输入节奏 ÷ 陈旧上界」这个比值**（本机实测相邻输入间隔
> p50 = 341 秒、≤1.5s 的仅 0.29%），**不是窗口本身多大**。复算：
> `node --experimental-strip-types scripts/hot-window-staleness.mjs` 与
> `scripts/hot-window-timeline.mjs`（**不接 `test:smoke` 链**，一次性量度）。
> 程序化连发（相邻输入 ≤1.5s）下这 12.6% 会变成真实代价 ⇒ 见 issue #63。

readme.section: 0.1.7 的 settings 体系变更（源码里唯一的大改）
readme.text:
> **宿主升级后请刷新页面**（不需要重启宿主）。客户端 bundle 由同一个宿主提供（`lib/client.js`），
> 所以版本偏斜只影响**升级前就已打开的旧标签页**，而那里的现象两个格子不一样（都按旧代码实读确认）：
> **热度列表会被清成空**（旧代码对缺省的 `hot` 判成 `null`，见 `1c205d6` 的 `src/client/index.ts:1840-1842`），
> **历史环则只是停更**（旧代码对 `history` 是「省略 = 保留现值」）。建议格不受影响，它还在 `_push` 里。
> 两者都不等于丢数据：热表的权威存储是 `suggest_ghost_hotness` 域（`src/hotness-store.ts:44-45`），
> `_hot` 只是给客户端的快照，刷新后即恢复。

三处细节是踩过才知道的：

readme.section: 0.1.7 的 settings 体系变更（源码里唯一的大改）
readme.text:
- **`Config` 不能整对象标 `.volatile()`**，也不能把 `z.object({…}).volatile().dict`
  摊平再 spread —— 前者会把策略参数一并暴露成表单，后者摊平时丢掉每个字段自己的
  `meta`，实测直接导致整张表单不可见。正确写法是**逐字段** `.volatile()`。
- **volatile 字段解析后是引用**（cosmokit 的 `Volatile<T>`），不是裸值，读值必须走
  `.get()`。因此加了一层 `flattenConfig()` 把引用拍平成裸值，上层代码对代次无感；
  它同时认得裸值形态，所以 0.1.5 及更早的代次照样工作。
- **`provider` / `model` 从 `z.string().min(1)` 改成 `.default('')`**：标进表单后
  必填会让插件「不填就不能启动」，而留空=继承主请求路由恰恰要求它是可选的。

readme.section: 其它跨代取舍
readme.text:
- **不用 `settingsNamespace()`**：该 helper 在 `0.1.2` 已被删除，运行时导入会让整个模块链接失败。它只是校验后原样返回 brand 字符串，故改用 `'suggest-ghost' as SettingsNamespace` 字面量断言。
- **不导入 `deepFreeze`**：`0.1.1` 由 `dsh-llm` 导出，`0.1.2` 把它迁到新增的 `dsh-util-values` 并停止转发，而该包在 `0.1.1` 内核中不存在 —— 换导入源只会反向破坏另一代，因此 `src/generate.ts` 自带一份等价实现（迭代遍历、循环引用安全、跳过 `AbortSignal`）。
- **client 端不从 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` 取类型**：该包是 `0.1.1` 内核特有，`0.1.2` 已拆走。`lib/client.js` 实测零内核导入（只需 `react`），跨代无关；`ctx.remote` 的最小面在 client 侧本地声明（见 `src/client/index.ts` 的 `RemoteLike`）。
- **`source.kind` 用 `'user'` 而非 `'plugin'`**：`0.1.7` 删了 `plugin` kind、新增的 `schedule` 在 `0.1.5` 又不存在，两代无交集，故取共有的 `user`。该字段只用于构造一次性 LLM 请求载荷，不参与持久化与投影。

readme.section: 已知取舍与限制
readme.text:
- **旧设置会迁移**：实测 `0.1.5` 时代改过的值（例如 `historyMaxEntries`）在 `0.2.0`
  上原样恢复：profile 文档里就存着非默认值（实测有 `historyMaxEntries: 77`、`historyCrossSession: true`），
  所以重启后读回的是这份持久值，而不是上一次运行的内存值。
- **client 侧无轮询**：0.1.7 随 `settingsScope` 一起移除的只是 `scope.subscribe`，
  内核另有转发给 client 的事件通道 —— `ctx.remote.$on('settings/document-updated')`
  （在 dsh-api-remotes 的转发白名单内，mode `emit`）。内核自己的设置页即用它驱动
  `SettingsDescribeMirror`。本插件同款订阅，只在 host 真推 `_push` 时才发
  `describe()`，另在首读与 `connection/reset` 时各读一次。

--dump-config` 校验 manifest 组装 —— **这一步在 0.2.0 上就会暴露 peer 门禁的拒绝**，再 `dsh --profile

"say hi"` 与 `dsh --profile

-- --no-open --port

` 观察插件加载。headless 启动停在 `MISSING_CREDENTIAL`（临时 home 无凭据），该点在插件加载之后。

readme.section: 开发
readme.text:
```
src/index.ts         host 入口：turn/end(completed) → 有界生成建议；Config（策略 + volatile 可编辑项）
src/coldstart.ts     冷启动语义（纯函数）：日志取环种子、回合语义校验、建议追踪
src/generate.ts      转录提取 → 脱敏 → ctx.llm.stream → 净化；flattenConfig 拍平 volatile 引用

readme.section: 改双向 settings 通道前必读
readme.text:
`_ops` / `_push` / `_hot` / `_residual` 是插件写进 settings 的全部通道（`_push` 与 `_hot`
是 host→client 的两格，客户端都读；`_residual` 是**宿主自用格**——装「读到过但所属会话始终
没进店所以判不了」的残留，#56，客户端不读它，所以它不进投影面），
改过的三个缺陷都长在通道语义上而不是业务逻辑
上：`mutate()` 的第三个参数是「我读到的 revision」而不是「我要覆盖的版本」，被拒时看起来像
写成功；zod schema 与 TS 联合类型是两份互不约束的真相，只改一边就静默丢载荷；单槽 last-wins
快照装不下「只存在一瞬间」的载荷。另外三条更容易反复踩到：`apply(ctx, config)` 捕获的
volatile 引用会在首次配置写入后冻结，`settings/document-updated` 挂在插件自己的 `ctx` 上
收不到，以及在它的回调里再发起任何 settings 写入都会被内核拒成 `HMR transactions cannot be
nested`（ALS 事务沿 `await` 传播，推迟一个 tick 不算逃出）。文档里另有一节讲清留痕为什么只能
走 stdout：`ctx.logger` 在健康进程里不落任何地方，运行期唯一可见面是 `console.log` 经宿主
tee 进日志，所以本插件用语义标记 `[dsh-suggest-ghost][ops-trace]` 把留痕与调试噪声分开。

readme.section: 改双向 settings 通道前必读
readme.text:
Gitea 协作流程（评论命令的正确形式与回读、分支/PR 约定、`lib/` 与主仓纪律）见
[docs/gitea-workflow.md](docs/gitea-workflow.md)。

内核 settings 通道的坑见 [docs/internals-cordis-settings-pitfalls.md](docs/internals-cordis-settings-pitfalls.md)：
每条按「症状 → 根因 → 正确用法 → 错误用法」写，附源码行号与 commit，并区分「已修」「待宿主
验证」「内核契约」「仅本插件经验」四档确定性，文末是改动前后的复查清单。

readme.section: 改代码前：哪份副本会被宿主加载
readme.text:
**结论：宿主加载的是 `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-suggest-ghost` 这条符号链接解析到的工作副本，
不是你正在编辑的那一个。** 本机现状：

```
~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-suggest-ghost
  -> ~/workspace/dsh-plugins/dsh-suggest-ghost
```

配套事实有两条，都会决定一轮验证算不算白跑：

- 本仓 `lib/` **纳入版本管理**，宿主 `import('dsh-suggest-ghost')` 加载的是 `lib/index.js`
  （`package.json` 的 `main`）与 `lib/client.js`（`exports["./client"]`）。`src/*.ts` 只是源，
  改完 `src/` 不重建就请求重启，加载的仍是旧字节码。
- 仓库可能同时存在多个 git worktree（并行修多个 issue 时必然如此），链接只指向其中一个。
  在别的副本里改、构建、重启，都不会生效。

readme.section: 改代码前：哪份副本会被宿主加载
readme.text:
开工前跑这两条，都是只读的：

```bash
node scripts/artifact-freshness.mjs   # lib 是否比 src 旧（2s 容差）；部署链接指向哪个副本
node scripts/gitignore-check.mjs      # 有没有「已跟踪却被 ignore 覆盖」的目录，fatal 退出码非 0
```

`gitignore-check` 挡的是一类静默失效：`lib/` 必须入库，所以一条盖住它的规则（`.gitignore` 里的
`build/`、`lib/`、`src/` 之类，或 `~/.config/git/ignore` 里的全局规则）会让**该目录下新建的文件
从此不进索引**。文件在盘上、构建照常、`git status` 一片干净，而 `git checkout` 恢复不出它们，
因为 git 从来不知道它们存在。这条判据本身有个易踩的坑：`git check-ignore` 默认**跳过已跟踪路径**，
必须加 `--no-index`，否则恰好查不到这种状态。

readme.section: 改代码前：哪份副本会被宿主加载
readme.text:
改动落盘与验证的顺序（本仓多次因为跳过后半程返工）：

1. 在你的 worktree 里改完，跑 `pnpm run test:smoke`（全绿再动下一步）；
2. `node build.mjs` 重建 `lib/`，把 `src/` 与 `lib/` **一起提交**；
3. `node scripts/artifact-freshness.mjs` 确认产物不陈旧、且指向的副本就是你要宿主加载的那份；
4. 再请求重启。未提交的改动不要拿去验证：并发会话或其他工具对工作区的写入是不可预期的，
   提交过的内容才追得回来。

readme.section: 宿主层改动怎么不重启就生效
readme.text:
改 `src/index.ts` → `node build.mjs` 之后，**默认配置下要重启宿主才生效**，但这是
profile 配置的结果，不是平台限制。DSH 自带插件热重载（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-hmr`），本 profile
没开它的源码监听：合成配置里那个条目是 `config: { root: [] }`，而它的 README 写明
`root` 为 `[]` 时「只保留 explicit configuration watches」，即只监听 profile 的配置文件。

第二层原因更容易踩：默认 `ignored` 是
`["**/node_modules", "**/.*", "cache", "data"]`，而开发期的本插件是以
`link:` 形式挂在 `profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-suggest-ghost` 下的。所以**即便把 `root`
配成 `["."]`，默认 ignore 规则也照样把它排除在监听之外**。

readme.section: 宿主层改动怎么不重启就生效
readme.text:
要开监听，在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 末尾加一段（`root` 收窄到本插件产物目录，
别让 chokidar 去遍历整个 node_modules）：

```yaml
- id: hmr
  disabled: false
  config:
    root:

这段的合法性可以先不启动就验：`dsh --profile web --patch <这个文件> --dump-config`，
对照 `id: hmr` 是否带上这三项、其余条目行数不变。

开起来之后的判据就在日志里，不用猜：本插件每次挂载都打一行

```
[dsh-suggest-ghost][ops-trace] apply called; artifact mtime=<那份 lib/index.js 的 mtime>
```

readme.section: 宿主层改动怎么不重启就生效
readme.text:
`touch lib/index.js` 后再看这一行：mtime 变了就说明热重载把新构建换进来了；mtime 不变
就说明还在旧字节码上，此时无论验证结果如何都不作数（这正是 issue #20 那类白跑一轮）。
客户端侧不需要宿主重启：browser 侧有独立的模块加载机制，刷新页面即可。

不想手工做这些就用 `pnpm run sandbox`（`scripts/dev-sandbox.mjs`）：独立 `DSH_HOME`、独立插件产物副本、
自动避开被占用的端口、剥掉会重放的遗留载荷，并把该 grep 的留痕串打印出来。脚本本体不含任何插件专有
知识，本仓专有的值放在 `package.json` 的 `sandbox` 字段（`entry` / `rewrites` / `disable` / `greps`）。

readme.section: 宿主层改动怎么不重启就生效
readme.text:
> 限制：`hmr/change` 的重载走内核的 `runExclusive` 事务，因此**重载期间**插件在事件回调里
> 发起的 settings 写入同样会被拒（`docs/internals-cordis-settings-pitfalls.md` 陷阱 1.5）。
> 重载后第一次 `_ops` 清空失败属预期，不代表改动没生效，判据是 `apply called` 那行的 mtime。

readme.section: 冷启动语义（重启后为何立即可用）
readme.text:
重启后「没有数据」并非真的没数据：**历史在会话日志里，建议由 host 按语义校验后重推**。
所谓冷启动问题，本质是判据选错了——旧实现用「时间」（重启即作废、事件到达才播种）当判据，
于是留下两个空窗。现在统一改为**语义**判据：

readme.section: 冷启动语义（重启后为何立即可用）
readme.text:
- **历史环**是会话日志的缓存：pull 到达时未命中就从日志现算（`ringFor`），不存在「播种时机」，
  也就没有「pull 抢在首个事件之前 → 回空」的竞态。会话活跃期间由 `session/event` 增量维护。
- **建议**是否可用，取决于它对应的回合是否仍是该会话的最后一个已完成回合（`suggestionIsCurrent`）。
  host 每次组装状态都经这道校验：有效则原样恢复（打开页面即见上一轮建议，不等新回合）；
  可判定为陈旧则清场。
- 三条推送路径（pull 应答 / 回合结束 / 热度恢复补推）共用同一份状态组装（`statePushOf`），
  不再各写各的；client 侧 pull 统一在会话绑定成功处发起，冷启动、切会话、会话晚就绪三合一。
- 热度表恢复完成后（`whenReady`）补推一次完整快照，关掉「恢复窗口内推送了不完整频次」的窗口。

readme.section: 冷启动语义（重启后为何立即可用）
readme.text:
> 与 0.1.5 的差别：那时 `_push` 落 `settings.yaml`，重启后可回读盘上残留的上一条建议。
> `0.1.7+` 之后**别把"volatile 字段不落盘"当成保证**：本插件的 `_ops` / `_push` 实测就写在
> profile 文档里（`cordis.patch.yml` 中能看到 `_ops: '{"rev":…}'`、`_push: '{"rev":…}'` 两行），
> 而"消费后清空 `_ops`"在事件回调里会被内核按 nested transaction 拒掉，所以载荷会长期留在盘上。
> 直接后果是**新实例一启动就重放上一进程遗留的 op**（隔离实例实测：客户端还没连上就消费了一条
> `complete`）。历史前缀补全与热度面板照常可用——它们走会话日志与 storage 域。
> 注意区分：用户的**设置值**同样在 profile 文档里、照常迁移（见「已知取舍与限制」）。

readme.section: 冷启动语义（重启后为何立即可用）
readme.text:
```bash
pnpm run build       # tsc 编译 host + esbuild 打包 client → lib/
pnpm run test:smoke  # 纯函数冒烟测试（含热度持久化语义、冷启动语义）
pnpm run test:e2e    # 真实栈端到端：热度落盘→重启恢复；冷启动重启对账/pull 应答
pnpm run replay      # 用真实会话日志回放补全管线

readme.section: 已知限制
readme.text:
- 跨会话热度表已持久化（宿主 storage 域，落 `~/.dsh/storages/suggest_ghost_hotness.json`）：重启后频次恢复，不再从零累积；宿主无 storage 域（如极简 headless 组合）时自动降级为内存态，重启清零
- **别把「volatile 字段不落盘」当保证**：本插件的 `_ops` / `_push` 实测就写在 profile 文档里，而"消费后清空
  `_ops`"在事件回调里会被内核按 nested transaction 拒掉，所以载荷长期留在盘上，新实例一启动就会重放它
  （隔离实例实测：客户端还没连上就消费了一条遗留 `complete`）。详见上方冷启动一节与 issue #22
- 重启后历史补全与上一轮建议立即可用（判据是语义而非重启时机）；但**新回合**的建议仍需等该回合跑完才能生成——这是「预测下一条」的固有代价，不是启动延迟
- 热度管理面板显示并过滤的是推送的 top-K 快照（默认 50 条，「共 N 条」展示全量）；更大范围的主机侧搜索未做
- 删除只清当前统计——再次输入同文本会重新计入；「固定」才是不被淘汰的语义
- LLM 建议只覆盖当前会话；把其他会话文本并作候选需开启「跨会话搜索」
- 每个完成回合都会调一次建议模型（与输入框是否有内容无关），不需要时可在设置里关闭省 token

readme.section: dsh-suggest-ghost
readme.text: > Input prediction plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web: after each turn completes, one auxiliary LLM call predicts your next prompt and renders it as ghost text in the input box when the draft is empty; while you type, it completes from the current conversation history by prefix match. **Tab** accepts the whole suggestion, **→** accepts word by word.

readme.section: What it is
readme.text: A pure plugin mount (host listens to turn events + client-side DOM overlay) — no changes to any DSH core code. Three modes switch automatically:

readme.section: What it is
readme.text:
- **LLM next-suggestion** (empty draft): after every completed turn, the last round of conversation is sanitized and sent to the suggestion model (inherits the main request route by default, no extra config) to produce "the sentence you are most likely to type next" — the same experience as Claude Code.
- **History prefix completion** (non-empty draft): zsh-autosuggestions style — finds prefix-matching entries in conversation history, scores by recency first, with in-session frequency and cross-session hotness as secondary signals, and renders the remaining part in gray. Full/half-width punctuation, whitespace, and case differences do not affect matching. Immediate, no network.
- **Pause completion** (non-empty draft): once typing pauses for `inlineDelayMs` (default 100ms) a completion request goes out and the rest of the sentence appears as ghost text at the caret; Tab accepts the whole thing, `→` accepts word by word. **Latency expectation**: `inlineDelayMs` only decides *when the request is sent*; the model itself measured **1.1-17s** (42 generations in the real environment on 2026-10-20: fastest 1100ms, median 4900ms, slowest 16986ms), so waiting a moment after pausing usually

readme.section: What it is
readme.text: Ghost text is rendered as a DOM overlay approximation (follows the input's font and scroll), not depending on the official `setGhost` input capability, so it works on rc.6; keystrokes are not intercepted during IME composition.

readme.section: Preview
readme.text:
**① History prefix completion** (non-empty draft) — type "list do" and the ghost completes the remainder of that historical message:

**② LLM next-suggestion** (empty draft, auto-predicts your next step after a turn ends):

readme.section: Preview
readme.text: Dark text = what you typed; gray = ghost suggestion. **Tab** accepts the whole suggestion, **→** accepts word by word. Ghost text follows the input's font and scroll rendering — it never overlaps or steals focus; if you don't like it, just ignore it and keep typing and it disappears — zero cost.

readme.section: Installation
readme.text:
**From npm (recommended — prebuilt, no approval needed):**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-suggest-ghost
```

One-line install from GitHub (build artifacts are committed to the repo, no local build needed):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:WuJiaoJue/dsh-suggest-ghost"
```

Or from source:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/dsh-plugin-collection/dsh-suggest-ghost.git
cd dsh-suggest-ghost && pnpm install && pnpm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

readme.section: Installation
readme.text: After installing, restart dsh web and hard-refresh the page with Ctrl+Shift+R. Works out of the box with no configuration required.

readme.section: Configuration
readme.text:
All settings live in the **Suggest ghost** card in Settings → Plugins and take effect immediately after saving:
card copy (field labels/hints, buttons, badges) follows the host DSH UI language (中文 / English) and updates in real time when the language is switched in Settings, without a refresh; hosts without a locale service fall back to Chinese.

readme.section: Configuration
readme.text:
| Group | Fields |
|---|---|
| LLM next-suggestion | enable toggle, max output tokens, max suggestion chars, reference turns, transcript char budget, timeout (ms), accept key, provider / model route (leave empty to inherit the main request), **suggestion reasoning effort `suggestionReasoningEffort` (empty by default = not sent)** |
| Pause completion | enable toggle, pause duration (default 100ms), min input chars (pause), completion length cap, **completion reasoning effort `completionReasoningEffort` (empty by default = not sent)** |
| History prefix completion | enable toggle, cross-session search, max history entries, min input chars (history), word-by-word accept |
| Hotness management | frequent cross-session phrases list: pin (exempt from eviction, always leads candidates), delete, manual add (pinned by default), clear all — takes effect immediately, no save needed |

readme.section: Configuration
readme.text: **Why the effort defaults to empty**: `reasoningEffort` is declared **per provider and per model**, it is not a global switch. 9 of the 18 models in this profile declare no `reasoningEfforts` at all (efficient / fast / lite, …), and sending any effort to those is rejected by the adapter **before the request goes out** (`UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT`, measured 0-20ms). So an empty string means the plugin does not write the key and the route keeps its own default. An effort the model does not declare still does not cost you the suggestion: the host retries once without it and logs `effort_rejected=1`. Do not use it as a "thinking off" switch either — only routes that explicitly declare `off` / `none` accept those values (qfmodel rejects even `off`; its profile declares low/medium/xhigh).

readme.section: Configuration

readme.section: Security
readme.text:
- Only the last round of conversation is sent to the suggestion model, with common credentials auto-masked before sending; output is purified and unqualified replies are silently discarded

readme.section: Compatibility
readme.text:
**Current status (2026-10-30)**: **six generations are supported** — `0.1.2-rc.1 / 0.1.5-rc.3 /
0.1.7-rc.1 / 0.1.7-rc.2 / 0.2.0-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.2`. `0.2.2-alpha.2` is registered in the generation
table and passes the assembly / admission / type / projection faces, but it is a **prerelease line and
not a promise about `0.2.2` proper**. `0.1.1-rc.2` was **dropped**: its front end has no
`remote.settings` service, and cordis parks a whole fiber when a declared inject cannot be resolved —
the hard-constraint evidence and the control experiment live in `scripts/cross-kernel/FINDINGS.md`.
Everything below that mentions `0.1.1-rc.2` is historical.

readme.section: Compatibility
readme.text:
Three reading rules: **undetermined ≠ green** (the first two generations have no gate at all, so an
assembly GREEN does not prove admission was verified); an enumerated peer list ≠ the kernel's matching
rule (see the two-calibre note below); and the UI face is the only one that answers "did the user
actually see it" — it is also the one the other four faces most easily hide.

readme.section: Peer enumeration, and the hard gate that starts at 0.2.0
readme.text:
Peer deps are written as an **explicit generation list** (`^0.1.2-rc.1 || ^0.1.5-rc.1 || ^0.1.7-rc.2 ||
^0.2.0-rc.2` — all six `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peers carry exactly this string) rather than `>=0.1.2-rc.1`.
The reason splits into two calibres, and they must not be conflated (measured 2026-10-30, FINDINGS §20.4):

readme.section: Peer enumeration, and the hard gate that starts at 0.2.0
readme.text:
- **Install side** (npm/pnpm resolving peers, no `includePrerelease`): node-semver excludes prereleases from
  every range unless a comparator carries the same `[major.minor.patch]` tuple, so `^0.1.2-rc.1` is false for
  `0.1.5-rc.1`, and so is `*` — **no range spans generations**, and every new rc needs another entry.
- **Admission side** (what the kernel actually runs: `semver.satisfies(v, range, { includePrerelease: true })`):
  measured, `^0.1.2-rc.1` **covers all of 0.1.x** (including `0.1.7-rc.1`), and `^0.2.0-rc.2` covers everything
  in `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0` (including `0.2.1-rc.5` and `0.2.2-alpha.2`) — while all of those are false on npm's calibre.

readme.section: Peer enumeration, and the hard gate that starts at 0.2.0
readme.text:
⇒ **"Add an enumeration entry" is an install-side concern, not an admission requirement.** That is why this repo
did **not** widen its peer ranges for an alpha line (doing so writes an unverified generation into the support
claim); when `0.2.2` ships both calibres cover it automatically, and the work is one new row in the generation
table plus a re-run.

readme.section: Peer enumeration, and the hard gate that starts at 0.2.0
readme.text:
**At `0.2.0` this stopped being an install-time hint and became a load-time hard rejection.** While composing a profile the kernel checks each peer with `semver.satisfies(runtimeVersion, range, { includePrerelease: true })` and skips the whole bundle on a miss:

```
dsh: skipping profile bundle "dsh-suggest-ghost": Error: Plugin … is incompatible
with dsh 0.2.0-rc.2: peerDependencies {…}
```

Two details worth remembering:

readme.section: Peer enumeration, and the hard gate that starts at 0.2.0
readme.text:
- the gate passes **`includePrerelease: true`**, but that is not a blank cheque: `^0.2.0` (without the rc) is still
  false for `0.2.0-rc.2` (false under both calibres) — admitting that generation takes the rc-carrying lower bound;
- `dsh plugin allow-version` grants an **exact-version** exemption, which bypasses the check rather than fixing it.
  On the admission side the real fix is registering the generation in `scripts/cross-kernel/generations.mjs` and
  re-running it; only the install side is fixed by adding an enumeration entry.

readme.section: The 0.1.7 settings rework (the only substantial source change)
readme.text: `0.1.7` removed the whole `settings.yaml` system, so the plugin's data channel had to move:

readme.section: The 0.1.7 settings rework (the only substantial source change)
readme.text:
| | `0.1.5` | `0.1.7+` |
|---|---|---|
| User-editable options | `ctx.settings.register(ns, schema, …)` | per-field `.volatile()` in `Config`; the kernel projects the **plugin's own Config schema** into a form, ns = Loader entry id |
| host → client | `_push` on a `SettingsScope` | `ctx.settings.update(ns, {_push, _hot})` (both volatile: `_push` = suggestion cell, `_hot` = hotness/history cell) |
| client reads | `settingsScope.bind(ns).get()` | `remote.settings.describe()` (first read + event-driven re-read) |
| client → host | `scope.set('_ops', …)` | `remote.settings.mutate(ns, [{op:'set',path:['_ops'],…}])` |
| change signal (host) | `scope.watch` | `settings/document-updated(ns, revision)` event |
| change signal (client) | `scope.subscribe` | `remote.$on('settings/document-updated')` |

readme.section: The 0.1.7 settings rework (the only substantial source change)
readme.text:
**The payload shape is unchanged** (the `_push` / `_ops` JSON, including the `suggestionSessionId` / `historySessionId` ownership guards) — only the carrier moved, so the client's parsing and ownership logic needed no rewrite.

Three details that only surface when you try them:

readme.section: The 0.1.7 settings rework (the only substantial source change)
readme.text:
- **`Config` must not be marked `.volatile()` as a whole**, and `z.object({…}).volatile().dict` must not be spread back in — the former exposes the strategy parameters as form fields too, the latter drops each field's own `meta` during flattening and makes the entire form invisible. Mark **per field**.
- **A volatile field resolves to a reference** (cosmokit's `Volatile<T>`), not a bare value, so reads must go through `.get()`. `flattenConfig()` flattens those references into plain values so the rest of the plugin is generation-agnostic; it also accepts bare values, so `0.1.5` and earlier keep working.
- **`provider` / `model` changed from `z.string().min(1)` to `.default('')`**: once they are form fields, being required means the plugin "cannot start until filled in", while the intended meaning of empty is "inherit the main request's route".

readme.text:

- **`source.kind` is `'user'`, not `'plugin'`**: `0.1.7` dropped the `plugin` kind and the `schedule` kind it added does not exist on `0.1.5`, so the two generations have no overlap. The field only builds a one-shot

readme.section: Known trade-offs
readme.text:
- **Old settings do migrate**: a value tweaked on the `0.1.5` settings page was measured restoring as-is on `0.2.0` — the profile document holds non-default values today (`historyMaxEntries: 77`, `historyCrossSession: true`), and a restart reads that persisted value rather than the previous run's memory.
- **Two host→client cells, one write**: `_push` carries only `{suggestion (+frame/final),
  suggestionSessionId, completion (+final), error}` while `_hot` carries only

readme.section: Which copy the host actually loads
readme.text:
**The host loads the worktree that `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-suggest-ghost` resolves to, not the one
you are editing.** On this machine:

```
~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-suggest-ghost
  -> ~/workspace/dsh-plugins/dsh-suggest-ghost
```

Two related facts decide whether a verification round counts:

readme.section: Which copy the host actually loads
readme.text:
- `lib/` is **committed to this repository**. The host imports `lib/index.js` (`package.json` `main`)
  and `lib/client.js` (`exports["./client"]`). `src/*.ts` is only source: edit `src/`, skip the build,
  restart the host, and it loads the previous bytecode.
- Several git worktrees can exist at once (unavoidable when issues are fixed in parallel), and the
  symlink points at exactly one of them. Changes built in any other copy never reach the host.

Both checks are read-only:

readme.section: Which copy the host actually loads
readme.text:
```bash
node scripts/artifact-freshness.mjs   # is lib/ older than src/ (2s tolerance); which copy is deployed
node scripts/gitignore-check.mjs      # tracked files covered by an ignore rule; fatal exits non-zero
```

readme.section: Which copy the host actually loads
readme.text:
The second check guards a silent failure mode. `lib/` has to stay tracked, so any rule that covers it
(`build/`, `lib/`, `src/` in `.gitignore`, or a rule in `~/.config/git/ignore`) makes **newly created
files in that directory stay out of the index**. The files are on disk, the build succeeds,
`git status` looks clean, and `git checkout` cannot restore them, because git never knew they existed.
One trap in the check itself: `git check-ignore` skips tracked paths unless you pass `--no-index`,
which is precisely the case worth catching.

readme.section: Which copy the host actually loads
readme.text:
1. Change your worktree, run `pnpm run test:smoke`, continue only when it is green.
2. Run `node build.mjs` and commit `src/` and `lib/` **together**.
3. Run `node scripts/artifact-freshness.mjs` to confirm the build is current and the deployed copy is
   the one you want the host to load.
4. Only then ask for a restart. Never verify uncommitted work: concurrent sessions and external tools
   write to this working tree without warning, and committed content is the only thing that comes back.

readme.text:
After editing `src/index.ts` and running `node build.mjs`, the default configuration needs a host
restart. That is a profile setting, not a platform limit: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-hmr` reloads plugin
source, but this profile composes it as `config: { root: [] }`, and its README says an empty `root`
keeps "only explicit configuration watches", i.e. the profile's config files only.

`["**/node_modules", "**/.*", "cache", "data"]`, and during development this plugin lives at
`profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-suggest-ghost` (a `link:` dependency). **Even `root: ["."]` would
not watch it**, because the ignore pattern excludes that path.

To watch it, append this to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (keep `root` narrow so Chokidar does
not walk all of node_modules):

```yaml
- id: hmr
  disabled: false
  config:
    root:

Validate the overlay without booting: `dsh --profile web --patch <file> --dump-config`, then check
that `id: hmr` carries those three keys and no other entry changed.

readme.section: Applying host-side changes without a restart
readme.text:
Once it is on, the log tells you whether a reload happened, so you never verify stale bytecode
again. Rather than doing this by hand, `pnpm run sandbox` (`scripts/dev-sandbox.mjs`) handles it: its own
`DSH_HOME`, its own copy of the plugin artifacts, automatic port avoidance, removal of leftover payloads
that would otherwise be replayed at boot, and it prints the greps worth watching. The script itself carries
no plugin-specific knowledge; that lives in this repo's `package.json` under `sandbox` (`entry`, `rewrites`,
`disable`, `greps`).

readme.section: Applying host-side changes without a restart
readme.text:
Every mount prints one line:

```
[dsh-suggest-ghost][ops-trace] apply called; artifact mtime=<mtime of the loaded lib/index.js>
```

`touch lib/index.js`, then look for that line again. A new mtime means the new build is in memory;
an unchanged mtime means the process is still running the previous bytes, so whatever the
verification shows is not about your change. Client-side work needs no host restart at all: the
browser module graph is loaded separately, so a page refresh is enough.

readme.section: Applying host-side changes without a restart
readme.text:
> Limitation: reloads run inside the kernel's `runExclusive` transaction, so settings writes the
> plugin issues from an event callback are refused during reload as well (pitfall 1.5 in
> `docs/internals-cordis-settings-pitfalls.md`). A failed `_ops` clear right after a reload is
> expected; judge the reload by the `apply called` mtime, not by that failure.

readme.section: Cold-start semantics (why it works right after a restart)
readme.text:
"No data after a restart" is a misreading: **history lives in the session log, and the host re-sends the suggestion after checking it semantically.**
The old design used *time* as the criterion (invalidate on restart, seed only when an event arrives), which left two gaps.
It now uses *semantics*:

readme.section: Cold-start semantics (why it works right after a restart)
readme.text:
- The **history ring** is a cache of the session log: on a pull miss it is recomputed from the log (`ringFor`), so there is no
  "seeding moment" and therefore no race where a pull arrives before the first event. Live sessions maintain it incrementally.
- A **suggestion** is valid iff its turn is still the session's last completed turn (`suggestionIsCurrent`). The host runs
  that check on every state assembly: still valid → restored as-is (your last suggestion is there when the page opens,
  no need to wait for a new turn); provably stale → cleared.
- All three push paths (pull reply / turn end / hotness-restore re-push) share one state assembler
  (`statePushOf`), and the client pulls at the single point where a session binding succeeds.

readme.section: Cold-start semantics (why it works right after a restart)
readme.text:
> **Difference from 0.1.5**: there `_push` landed in `settings.yaml`, so the previous suggestion could be read back
> after a restart. On `0.1.7+` volatile fields are not persisted, so **the last suggestion must be regenerated after a
> restart** — it returns as soon as the next turn completes. History prefix completion and the hotness panel keep working
> throughout, since they read the session log and the storage domain rather than a volatile field.
> Do not confuse this with your *settings values*, which do live in the profile document and do migrate (see Known trade-offs).

readme.section: Cold-start semantics (why it works right after a restart)
readme.text:
```bash
pnpm run build       # tsc compiles host + esbuild bundles client → lib/
pnpm run test:smoke  # pure-function smoke tests (incl. hotness persistence and cold-start semantics)
pnpm run test:e2e    # end-to-end over the real stacks: hotness persist→restore; cold-start reconciliation/pull
pnpm run replay      # replay the completion pipeline with real session logs

readme.section: Known limitations
readme.text:
- The cross-session hotness table is now persisted (host storage domain, lands in `~/.dsh/storages/suggest_ghost_hotness.json`): frequencies survive restarts instead of accumulating from zero; on hosts without the storage domain (older versions) it automatically degrades to in-memory only
- After a restart, history completion and the previous suggestion are available immediately (the criterion is semantic, not restart timing); a suggestion for a **new** turn still requires that turn to finish — that is inherent to "predict the next prompt", not a startup delay
- The management panel lists and filters the pushed top-K snapshot (50 entries by default; "N total" shows the full count); host-side search beyond the top-K is not implemented
- Delete only clears the current tally — typing the same text again re-counts; pin is the "never evicted" semantic
- LLM suggestions cover only the current session; to include text from other sessions as candidates, enable "cross-session search"
- Every completed turn triggers one suggestion model call (regardless of whether the input box has content); disable it in settings to save tokens if not needed
